warning_texts: The model behind this verdict is unverifiable: no output event of this CLI names a model, so 'executed on openrouter/z-ai/glm-5.3-flash' rests on self-reports, including mine.

Every modeled stage's recorded execution.model is 'openrouter/z-ai/glm-5.3-flash-fake' with parent 'max-driver-bb18e9826ca0' and 'driver e2e' summaries, and the machine-gate results carry no execution block at all; these are the artifacts' own claims, which this profile itself says cannot be verifie

The frozen plan's proof accepted gate_release_document's claims_rendered and caveats_rendered unproven (temp-dir FileNotFoundError), but the live gate did execute both rules over the real surfaces and passed 15 checks.

gate_metrics_machine never recomputes excluded_order_rows or excluded_outside_period from source, as its own unchecked.json records; I recomputed both from raw (27 = 26 not delivered + 1 outside period) and the identity 201 = 174 + 26 + 1 holds.

No deterministic rule anywhere in the frozen check plan or release surface contract reads a claim's population field, which is how the relabel survived every gate; the only check of that wording was this stage.

All four worker carries list raw_data/orders.csv in do_not_reread although a raw source is not a previous stage's output; no number depended on it because the claims machine gate recomputed from raw independently.

None of the three RESOLVED rulings looks contradicted by the data; refund_rate_basis is the only one that moves a number materially (0.473684 on paying customers vs 0.189655 on order rows) and its caveat is rendered on every surface, so the reader can see the choice.

The internal code of checklib, run_gate.py and release_surface_gate.py sits outside my allowed inputs, so the machine gates are taken as their recorded outputs, each of which I reproduced independently and found no discrepancy with.

Retry history and stale inputs were not checked by this stage - the human reads them in audit_runner.py report - and the worker stage results carry a single check each with empty disclosures, so stage-level self-reporting is thin.
Headless run renders nothing visual: report.md was read as text with anchors and comments stripped, dashboard_data.json as the values a dashboard would show, and no image rendering was attempted.
